scientific_integrity: Claim relies on an analytic Hilbert--Schmidt reduction and Wiener--Hopf parametrix; numerical spot checks are not proofs; independence not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact Fredholm essential spectrum for real b>0 on ordinary H^2; no complete spectrum or Fredholm index. A potentially broader unidentified homogeneous-kernel theorem remains an originality risk.
title: The beta-curve Fredholm spectrum of generalized Hilbert operators on \(H^2\)
